== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Bel Calem is a city that serves as the seat of power for the Overlord. It features diverse architecture, ranging from pale brick houses on its outskirts to a central district constructed from precious metals, rare stones, and imported woods. The city is enclosed by [[stone]] walls that stand approximately twelve feet high. Within the city, there are large structures such as [[Malachi]]'s great hall, which contains [[stone]] columns and arches reminiscent of an ancient coliseum, as well as well-appointed offices containing extensive libraries. The city is also a location where individuals may face judgment or be sent as sacrifices. Bel Calem has been the site of significant conflict and [[destruction]]. It was heavily damaged by the [[Naraka Incarnation]], which burned entire city blocks and left much of the city in flames. During these periods of chaos, the streets have been occupied by ash hounds and other large creatures like the akna'dorma. The city is also patrolled by guardians and has been a setting for battles involving [[Travelers]] and gold-armored warriors.}}

== House of Blades ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Bel Calem is a city characterized by twelve-foot-tall [[stone]] walls and houses constructed from wood, [[stone]], pale brick, or precious metals. Serving as the seat of the Overlord, this location is the place of origin for [[Leah]], who commands [[Yakir]] to transport her there. After spending several weeks within the city, it remains a destination that [[Alin]] desires to reach. The location is also noted in the mentions of [[Cormac]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Bel Calem serves as the home of Adrienne{{!}}Adrienne Lamarkis Daiasus and can be reached by traveling through [[Naraka]]. Located a four day's journey from [[Enosh]] over land, the area was a place where [[Kai]] conducted business. Furthermore, it is a location where ash resulting from the [[destruction]] of Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation could be scattered.}}
